tool.name: ampvis2 rarefaction curve
tool.description: Generates rarefaction curves for each sample using ampvis2
tool.command: Rscript --vanilla <<__RSCRIPT__ library(ampvis2) library(ggplot2) data <- readRDS("${input_dataset}") metadata <- readRDS("${metadata}") plot <- amp_rarecurve(data, metadata) ggsave(filename="${output_file}", plot=plot, device="${output_format}") __RSCRIPT__

param.name: input_dataset
param.label: Ampvis2 RDS dataset
param.help: The ampvis2 RDS dataset generated by previous tools

param.name: metadata
param.label: Metadata RDS file
param.help: Metadata file generated by ampvis2 tools

tool.help:
# Ampvis2 Rarefaction Curve
## What it does Generates rarefaction curves showing the relationship between the number of reads and observed OTUs for each sample. The plot can be faceted by metadata variables.
## Input - Ampvis2 RDS dataset: Output from previous ampvis2 tools - Metadata RDS file: Metadata generated by ampvis2 tools
## Output - Rarefaction curve plot in HTML, PNG, or PDF format
